climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

land: Faces the midday sun. In a climate this cool, that extra warmth is often what gets grapes fully ripe.

blurb.text: A Loire Valley appellation making wine only from Chenin, in the commune of Savennières. Most Loire Valley production is white, from Chenin Blanc, Sauvignon Blanc and Melon.
